glossary.definition: (A) "Person" means an individual, a partnership, a corporation, or an association.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5905.01 to 5905.19 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (B) "Veterans' administration" means the veterans' administration, its predecesssors, or successors.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5905.01 to 5905.19 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (C) "Income" means moneys received from the veterans' administration and revenue or profit from any property wholly or partially acquired therewith.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5905.01 to 5905.19 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (D) "Estate" means income on hand and assets acquired partially or wholly with "income."
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5905.01 to 5905.19 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (E) "Benefits" means all moneys paid or payable by the United States through the veterans' administration.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5905.01 to 5905.19 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (F) "Administrator" means the administrator of veterans' affairs of the United States or his successor.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5905.01 to 5905.19 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (G) "Ward" means a beneficiary of the veterans' administration.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5905.01 to 5905.19 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (H) "Guardian" means any fiduciary for the person or estate of a ward.
